findings.title: Pass a user record to the association delete
findings.body: `group.users.delete` expects associated user records, but this passes the integer `user_id`. ActiveRecord can raise an association type mismatch instead of removing the membership, so the new remove-member endpoint can return a 500 and leave the member in the group. Look up the user or delete the membership by ID through an appropriate relation.

findings.title: Exact page-size counts produce an extra page
findings.body: Using `floor(user_count / limit) + 1` reports an extra page whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size. For example, 50 members at a limit of 50 shows page 1 of 2 and enables Next, which loads an empty page. Use a ceiling-based page count.

findings.title: Removing the last member on a page can leave the list empty
findings.body: The offset is clamped to `user_count`, but an offset equal to the new count is past the last member. If a user removes the only member on the final page, the reload requests that offset and displays an empty page even though earlier members remain. Clamp to the start of the last valid page when the count decreases.
